For My Dearest Muhsii 🎂

Unna pathi evlo sollanum nu nenachalum, sila vishayangalukku vaarthaigal pathaadhu. Nee en life-la vandhadhula irundhu, chinna chinna moments kooda romba happy-a maari pochu. Un sirippu paatha pothum, oru naal full-ah evalo kastam irruntha kooda marandhuruven. 🥹

Nee santhosama irukkanum eppothume athukkaga naa ennavennalum seiven , edhu nadandhaalum unnakku naa irrrukken kavalapadatha . Naa eppavume un kuda iruppen .Enna nadanthalum unna vittu poga maaten. ✨

Unakku edhu venumnalum, nee thaniya handle pannanum nu ninaikkaadha… naan irukken.
Unakku oru smile theva naalum, oru vaarthai pesanum naalum, summa silent-ah irukkanum naalum… unnakku epo naa theva naalum apo naan iruppen. 🫂

Indha birthday unakku marakka mudiyadha oru azhagana ninaivaa irukkanum.
Eppovume ippadiye sirichittu iru, Muhshii. Adhu dhaan unakku romba azhaga irukkum. ❤️

With care,
𝓐𝓪𝓭𝓱𝓲𝓲𝓲 ❤️

HAPPY BIRTHDAY, MUHSII! 🎂🎉❤️

Life-la enna maari changes vandhaalum, days epdi maarinaalum, namma surroundings evlo different-a aanaalum… sila vishayangal mattum maarave maaradhu. Adhula onnu nee enakku evlo important-nu naan nenaikkuradhu. 🥹

Unakku ellame perfect-ah irukkura days-la mattum illa…
edhuvum seriyaa pogala nu thonura days-layum, nee romba tired-ah irukkura moments-layum, pesa vaarthaiye illaama silent-ah irukkura nerathulayum… un pakkathula oru epavume intha Aadhiii oda presence irukkum.

Unakku edhaavadhu achieve pannumbodhu santhosama celebrate pandra oruthana....
Nee fail aanaalum, “parava illa… next time paathukalaam” nu sollura oruthana.....
Nee confused-ah irrukkum pothu, unakkaga time eduthu kekkura oruthana.....

Ipadi ella nerathulaiyum ellamavum naa kuda irrupen .❤️

Un life-la enna nadandhaalum unnakkaga un kuda irrunthu naa unna paathupen. 🫂

Adhu dhaan naan unakku kudukka virumbura oru nambikkai.

Indha birthday unakku oru birthday mattum illaama, romba naal nyabagam vachirukka koodiya oru azhagana ninaivaa irukkanum. 🥹🎂✨

Eppovume ippadiye iru, Muhsii…
Un sirippu mattum maarama irukkattum. ❤️

— Aadhiii ❤️
